assumptions: The Devpost requirement 'a runtime file that can run the agent network in the browser' is satisfied by a JavaScript file (runtime.js) published on the site itself; the spec's reference implementation is likewise a set of browser JavaScript modules.

Manifest keys beyond the spec-named name / front_man / hocon (llm, peer_policy, allowed_peers, runtime, links, mcp) follow the field names used in the spec text and the official example bundles; unknown keys are metadata for other runtimes and do not affect loading.

Site actions are declared inside the network definition under a site_actions extension field on the agent that uses them, because the minimum profile registers site actions with the runtime rather than serialising their handlers in the network data.
description: A small dependency-free browser runtime that loads this site's agent-manifest.json and sentinel_watchdog.network.json, validates the network, registers the site's read-only site actions, and runs the front agent with bounded steps. It is the 'runtime' file for this site: open index.html, or call SentinelRuntime.boot() from any page that includes runtime.js.
name: sentinel-watchdog-runtime

implemented: Loads agent-manifest.json and resolves the network definition declared in it (name / front_man / hocon fields, spec section 3.3)
Parses and validates the JSON network definition before any execution: unique agent names, front agent exists, every tool reference resolves (spec section 3.1)
Runs the front agent and agent-to-agent delegation with finite bounds (max steps, per-call timeouts)
Registered site actions with name, purpose, and effect classification; arguments are fixed by the runtime, read-only, same-purpose public JSON-RPC reads (spec sections 1.2, 3.1)
Reports outcomes accurately: live reads are labelled live; on RPC failure the runtime falls back to the last verified snapshot and labels it as a snapshot, never as live data
Optional visitor BYOK profile (router base URL, model, key) stored only in caller-origin localStorage; the key is never sent to this site, the manifest, or any peer (spec section 4)
profile.name: Minimum Viable Specification for a Worldwide Agentic Web
not_yet_implemented: Full LLM agent loop with streaming and model tool-calling (Week 1 executes the network's deterministic tool path; the reference nsDeploy runtime is the Week 2 adoption target)
Loading peer networks by URL with the consent flow (spec section 3.2) - no peers are bound yet, see links.json
MCP tool calls (no MCP facade is published, see agent-mcp.json)
Coded-tool bundles in a Web Worker sandbox (not used by this network)
profile.version: MVP Profile 0.2 (6 November 2026, Cognizant AI Lab)

reference_runtime.name: nsDeploy browser runtime (reference implementation named by the spec)
reference_runtime.note: Week 2 evaluates embedding the reference runtime next to this site's own runtime.js for fuller profile conformance.
